labels: The student's cheek rests against one palm, with that elbow planted on the desk and the free hand lying beside an open book.; 학생의 볼이 한 손바닥에 닿고 해당 팔꿈치가 책상 위에 놓이며 반대 손은 열린 책 옆에 누워 있다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The student's cheek rests against one palm, with that elbow planted on the desk and the free hand lying beside an open book.
aliases: 턱 괴기와 팔꿈치 지지
